lead.headline: Warren and Wilson are slow and Lawrence scored 27 against you — Allen and Allgeier still to play
lead.deck: Down 74.7 to 63.7 at midday, but ESPN still has AVIATO at 75%. One check: Arizona's inactives at 12:35.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. An hour into the early games Jaylen Warren has 2.2 with Rico Dowdle back and taking carries, Garrett Wilson has 2.5 on two targets, and Bok-aneers' Trevor Lawrence threw four touchdowns in London for 27.3. London paid you too: Bhayshul Tuten scored three times for 24.7 and Ka'imi Fairbairn kicked the last-second winner. Your unplayed starters are Josh Allen at 14:25 and Tyler Allgeier at 14:05, Arizona's named starter with Jeremiyah Love out. The flex is a 12.4-to-12.4 coin flip with Terry McLaurin and stays as set. If Allgeier is on Arizona's 12:35 inactive list, McLaurin goes in; nothing in the reporting says he will be.
